# Ashvini Kumar

> 3D artist and social & editorial designer from Lucknow, India. Senior Designer & Video Editor at Animated Times and Graphic Designer at FandomWire (both since 2020); freelance Spline / Web3D designer and a top 1% Spline expert on Contra (4.86★). Also known as Ashwani Kumar. Works remotely with teams worldwide and can start immediately.

## Work
- [3D & Web3D portfolio](https://bettercallashvini.com/portfolio): product models and interactive Spline scenes, including work for HeyGen, Athletic Power and Mebrafino.
- [Social & editorial design](https://bettercallashvini.com/editorial): covers, thumbnails, review cards, retrospectives and data graphics for pop-culture publishers. Animated Times has 1.09M Facebook and 140K Instagram followers; FandomWire has 1.48M Facebook and 74K Instagram followers (public counts, Oct 2026).
- [About, experience and quick answers](https://bettercallashvini.com/about)
